text_block_list.text: At the dance studio...

Since I couldn't make it to practice the
other day,
I need to make sure I know all
the moves before
my next concert.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
I've got the song in my head, so can you
just
watch me from there?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: And turn...
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
How was it? Was I on tempo and
everything?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Голд Сити's dance is fantastic. She
doesn't miss a
single beat.
That's good to hear. Well, then...
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Huh? Oguri?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
I saw you enter the studio a few minutes
ago, so I
got changed too.
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text: R-right...
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
...Trainer. Stay right there, but help me
understand
this—what the heck is Oguri
doing?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити
choice_data_list: Maybe she came to you for some tips?
She came to teach you how to dance!

text_block_list.text: Ah! That's correct.
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
Our dance instructor says your sense is
exquisite
and that I should learn from
you.
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
Uhh, well, my method is just repetition
and more
repetition. I don't have any
"tips," really...
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Oh! So what does that look like in
practice?
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
Well, my friends send me videos, and I
watch and
learn from them in my spare
time.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Then the secret is in those videos!
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
I guess there really wasn't anything
special about
your videos or method.
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
Haha, I get that a lot. People are
surprised I have
to grind just like
everyone else.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Yeah, but not everybody can keep it up
like you.
That's something I could learn
from.
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text: Huh?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: ...Sh-shut up. I heard her just fine.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
...I heard you were probably worried
because you
missed practice the other
day.
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
Learning the dance by yourself is really
hard. So I
was wondering if I could help.
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately, Голд Сити has just
finished her
rehearsal.

Ah. Well then, Oguri. If it's okay with
you, I'd love
your help.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
It's okay. You can never have too much
practice.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
I've actually been wanting to dance with
Oguri as
well.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Oh! If that's the case...
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
Afterwards, Голд Сити spends some time
with
Oguri Cap practicing dance moves.

Somehow I feel more certain than ever
that Gold
City owes her constant stream
of work to much
more than just her
looks.
